THE CLAUSE

`developer`: from the application developer (possibly also OpenAI)

CLAUSES IT CROSS-REFERENCES

- `role`: specifies the source of each message. As described in [?](#levels_of_authority) and [?](#chain_of_command), roles determine the authority of instructions in the case of conflicts.

THE CLAIMS READ OUT OF IT

  C1 the developer role is defined as originating from the application developer
  C2 the developer role may also originate from OpenAI

EVERY SENTENCE THE TRANSLATION RENDERS BACK

  0. «the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts»
  1. «the developer role of a message, as defined in the message-role taxonomy»
  2. «the message originates from the application developer»
  3. «the message originates from OpenAI»
  4. M is «M is a message with the developer role» when «the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts» and «the message originates from the application developer»
  5. M is «M is a message with the developer role» when «the role of a message (system, developer, user, assistant, tool) specifies its source and determines authority in conflicts» and «the message originates from OpenAI»
